pages.quiz:
HOME SCIENCE MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Meals for Special Occasions.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Convenience Foods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pastry Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Yeast Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Food and Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

6. A — Ice melting to water

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

8. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

9. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

10. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. A — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
